profile: Mac Companion host Interactive role data plane v0.1
rules: one data-plane owner starts only after both authenticated role connections carry the same client, primary connection, session, and authorization epoch
input uses exact four-byte big-endian length framing and never reads beyond the declared strict JSON body
every input envelope must match the authenticated session and authorization epoch before the Agent forwards it to the generation-bound menu route
the media source yields one complete validated header and payload and the Agent awaits its network send before requesting the next record
every media header must match the authenticated session and authorization epoch and media sequence must strictly increase
failure, closure, cancellation, or fence mismatch on either direction cancels both role connections and requests exact session termination
role traffic carries no credential and cannot create, replace, renew, or broaden an Interactive lease
